question: Should MailerSend Sandbox mode (100 emails a month and 100 API requests a day, no payment method and no time limit, after an email-confirmed signup and an approval) be a separate record with identity email, beside email/mailersend, which keeps card for its 500-email Free plan?
why: Two tiers with different quotas and identity are two records, and a verify unit cannot add one. email/mailersend now names the signup and approval steps and says Sandbox mode needs no payment method in identity_cost.detail, and keeps card for its headline plan. Also unverified: how many emails one API or SMTP request may carry on the Free plan; the developer documentation states 500 email objects per request for the Professional trial and paid plans and 5 for Sandbox, and names no figure for Free.
